dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Indeed. I have all the spare money in the world but nothing to do with it, so shopping is my greatest hobby.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: My family also runs a business, so I check the market regularly to stay informed.

dialogues.speaker: Rie
dialogues.text: Oh, right. If you find anything interesting while checking the market out, remember to let me know.
